glossary.FirstMeasure: Property measurement/report service brand; do not translate.
glossary.organization/company: The customer business account, not an individual user.
glossary.report: A property measurement deliverable, usually roof or exterior measurements; other namespaces may use report for analytics.
glossary.roof pitch: The slope or steepness of a roof, not a sales pitch.
glossary.credit: In FirstMeasure billing, prepaid account value spent on reports, not lending or academic credit.
glossary.order: In report checkout, a purchased report request. In sorting controls it can mean sequence; use per-message context.
glossary.scope: In construction documents, the description of work to perform.
glossary.branch: An organizational subdivision or office, unless a technical context explicitly says otherwise.
glossary.channel: A group messaging conversation in communications features.
glossary.issued document: A finalized document whose language and measurements are frozen at issue time.

namespaces.billing: FirstMeasure prepaid report-credit purchase, balance and checkout.
namespaces.measurements: Property roof/exterior measurement reports and ordering.
namespaces.reports: Labels and spelling terms in FirstMeasure property measurement output.
namespaces.settings: Personal preferences and company administration. Distinguish employee settings from organization defaults.
namespaces.channels-ui: Inline team messaging and message translation controls.
namespaces.documents: Business document authoring, templates, issuing and viewing.
namespaces.canvassing: Map-based door-to-door prospecting and property/contact tracking.
namespaces.errors: User-visible API failures; preserve the meaning and do not translate error-code keys.
namespaces.terminology: Default names of business entities/features. Keys identify their application/domain.
namespaces.notifications: Company document delivery email text. Preserve recipient names, document types and URLs passed as placeholders.

settings/company_language_inherit.meaning: Dropdown choice that follows the current company language instead of fixing a personal override.

placeholders.name: Display name of the current company language, for example English (UK).

settings/company_language_label.meaning: Field label for the company default output language, independent of personal interface language.

settings/company_language_heading.meaning: Company settings card heading for default document/report language and measurement units.

notifications/document_greeting.meaning: Greeting in a document delivery email.

placeholders.name: Recipient display name; preserve the supplied value.

notifications/document_ready.meaning: Document delivery email announcing an issued document is ready for review.

placeholders.type: Document type supplied at runtime, such as proposal or invoice; avoid assuming its grammatical gender.

notifications/document_link.meaning: Document delivery email call to action followed by the document URL.
